en.headline: Ocean Park Halloween Fest returns from 5 September
en.dek: The park lists its 2026 Halloween Fest on the official programme, with haunted houses and an Under the Castle collaboration running into early November on designated dates.
body: Ocean Park Hong Kong is preparing to open Halloween Fest 2026 from 5 September, according to the park's official events listing and ticket pages, with the seasonal overlay described as running through 1 November on designated dates.

This year's programme is built around a collaboration with the original fantasy series Under the Castle. The park is advertising a haunted experience of that name at The Summit, alongside other walk-through attractions listed on its ticket site as Troublesome Night, Voodoo Boo Terror Park and Forbidden Asylum.

Ocean Park said combo tickets for those haunted experiences do not include general park admission. The park has also listed a Halloween Triple Terror Combo covering three of the houses on selected October and early November dates, with prices shown as HK$238 or HK$280 depending on the night.

Family daytime visits and night-time scare programmes are both part of the seasonal setup, the park said. Opening hours and the exact nights the haunted houses operate can change; the corporation advises checking its website before travelling to Aberdeen.
Correction: An earlier version of the Chinese text misrendered the name of one haunted house.

zh.headline: 海洋公園萬聖節活動9月5日起舉行
zh.dek: 公園官方節目及門票頁列出2026年萬聖節活動，指定日期設鬼屋及《Under the Castle》合作體驗，活動描述為舉行至11月1日。
body: 海洋公園正籌備2026年萬聖節活動，官方活動及門票頁顯示節日將由9月5日起舉行，並指在指定日期延續至11月1日。
今屆節目圍繞原創奇幻作品《Under the Castle》合作，公園在山頂正門一帶宣傳相關鬼屋體驗，門票頁同時列出「搗蛋鬼屋」、「巫毒驚嚇樂園」及 Forbidden Asylum 等步行體驗。
海洋公園表明，鬼屋組合票並不包括園區入場。門票頁亦列出「三重驚嚇組合票」，在10月及11月初部分晚上涵蓋其中三個體驗，票價顯示為238元或280元，視乎日子而定。
公園指日間家庭活動與夜間驚嚇節目會一併安排。開放時間及鬼屋實際開放日期或會更改，當局呼籲前往香港仔前先查閱官方網頁。
更正：早前中文稿將其中一座鬼屋名稱誤寫，現已改用公園英文原名 Forbidden Asylum。
